annotations.title: Hand a task to the WordPress operator (AI)

description: Hand a task for a WordPress site to its operator — plugins, theme, posts, pages, menus, settings, updates, WooCommerce: 'install a contact form plugin', 'create an imprint page'. The operator reads the site and returns a plan. Nothing changes yet: tell the user the plan waits for their confirmation in the WordPress cockpit (review_path). Pass the task complete and in the user's language. Uses the AI quota. Site ids come from list_wordpress_sites.

environment.description: live (default) or sandbox — only if the user names the test copy.

instruction.description: The task, concrete and complete (3–600 characters).

name: create_wordpress_task
